original_idea.body:
# Causal Chain: From Misuse Detection to Behavioral Update — How Long Does the Patch Cycle Take?

**Problem:** When misuse is detected (GTG-1002, vibe hacking), the causal chain from detection to model behavioral update is unknown in duration and reliability.

**Direction:** For GTG-1002 and vibe hacking cases, document the publicly available timeline from first misuse to detection to public disclosure to claimed behavioral update. Estimate the detection-to-patch latency. Compare to software vulnerability patch cycle benchmarks.

**Why it matters:** If the detection-to-patch cycle is 6+ months, governance relying on post-hoc behavioral correction is too slow to prevent harm from discovered attack vectors. This is the AI equivalent of 'patch Tuesday' governance.

**Relevant context:** GTG-1002 timeline; vibe hacking Aug 2025 report timing; software patch cycle benchmarks.
